What We Do

Construction-Ready BIM Solutions

Complete, parametric BIM documentation for global AEC firms — ensuring high-performance spaces with technical precision.

01 ——
Revit BIM Modeling

Full parametric BIM models developed to LOD 350–400, covering architectural, structural, and MEP systems with meticulous accuracy.

02 ——
Construction Documentation

Complete CD sets including floor plans, sections, elevations, details, schedules, and specifications — permit-ready and construction-grade.

03 ——
MEP Coordination

Integrated mechanical, electrical, and plumbing layouts coordinated within the architectural model for constructability and clash-free documentation.

04 ——
Interior & Millwork Drawings

Detailed interior elevations, kitchen and bathroom layouts, joinery details, and finish schedules developed to contractor level.

05 ——
AEC Detail Packages

Architectural and engineering specifications — wall assemblies, thresholds, parapet details, pergola plans, stair sections — built to AEC standards.

06 ——
QA-QC & Coordination

Rigorous quality assurance workflows with multi-level review cycles, ensuring accuracy, consistency, and compliance across all deliverables.

How We Work

Cloud-Powered Efficiency

A seamless, remote-first workflow built for global architecture firms — secure, real-time, and always accessible.

01
Project Intake & Setup
We receive your drawings, standards, and Revit templates. A centralized BIM 360 workspace is established within 24 hours.
02
BIM Development
Our team builds parametric models and documentation in Revit, working on a shared centralized model with real-time coordination.
03
QA-QC Review
Multi-level quality checks by Project Manager and Lead before every milestone delivery — accuracy and consistency guaranteed.
04
Delivery & Revisions
Files delivered via BIM 360 or preferred platform. Revision cycles managed efficiently with version control throughout.
Cloud Infrastructure
BIM 360 Collaboration — Teams work on centralized models in real-time, ensuring seamless coordination across disciplines and time zones.
24/7 Redundant Google Cloud Server — Uninterrupted, secure access with consistent version control and disaster recovery.
Secure Access Controls — Project data protected with role-based permissions and encrypted transfer protocols.
Global Reach — Supporting US, UK, and AUS firms from our New Delhi base — your timezone is always covered.
